request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:CATAPULT

layers.text: Recolour only the light blue hide of the face, body, legs and tail: it becomes a clear mid slate blue, colour #4a78b8 on the lit side with #2c4470 shadows, not grey and not pale, with dark navy #1a2748 along the top of the back. Do not redraw anything. Keep the deep blue frill with its orange rim and two orange eye-spots, the cream horns, beak, studs and belly, the eyes, pose, proportions, black outline and style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
